items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Jam sessions along with the Olympia Brass Band. We'll probably meet other bands and sort of get together and guys be trying to show Nick Scott what he can do on his own.

ctx.x: I was just going to say, did you jam much with guys to pick up anything in jam sessions, ideas and stuff?

Yeah, there will be a lot of jam sessions for us. I play most of my jam sessions. Jam sessions along with the Olympia Brass Band. We'll probably meet other bands and sort of get together and guys be trying to show Nick Scott what he can do on his own. And I'm trying to do the same thing. And to be surprised too, when you get in a position like that you do things that are really unexpected. You don't think you can do but you've done it. And you can realize this and say well this was something I didn't know I could…
What about the zip code? Do they play paid jobs or they just?
